opportunities.title: Small grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March (annual, UK office, decision in May)
15 September (annual, UK office, decision in November)
15 December (annual, UK office, decision in March)
28 February (annual, Japan office, decision in April)
30 September (annual, Japan office, decision in November)

amount.raw: Generally £1,500-£5,000; only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel up to £2,000 (≤13 days) or £2,500 (14+ days) per person; PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000 for PhD travel to UK.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. PhD students must include a letter of support from their supervisor.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

deadlines.raw: 1 December (annual, for decision in March of the following year)

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants. Must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses, conference and publication costs.
